overclaims: In mid-2025, Altman called AGI not a useful term.
A profit-based contractual AGI definition between Microsoft and OpenAI, first reported in December 2024, stayed in force through 2025.
This statement says the contractual definition stayed unchanged, so it was in force throughout 2025.
checks.note: The supplied Fortune text does not substantiate the attributed Altman remark. The February 2026 statement that the definition was unchanged does not establish that the December 2024 profit threshold remained continuously in force throughout 2025. Citation fields and the agreed outcome otherwise match.
